description: Verified East End venue closures, with dates. With `name`, the answer is a verdict on that one venue either way, including venues the guide lists as operating. Without `name`, the answer is the most recently confirmed closures. Each closure is classed as permanently closed, temporarily closed (may reopen), or never-existed (a place a data sweep invented and an audit could not find), and carries the date the guide confirmed it and who reported it. `townScope` reports how the place argument was read; `townScope.recognized: false` means the name matched no East End place, the rows array is empty, and `didYouMean` lists near matches where any exist.

name.description: Venue to check, e.g. 'Bay Burger'. Omit to list recent closures.

since.description: ISO date, only closures dated on or after this

name: recently_closed
title: Closed venues + is-it-still-open check
